Profile

Bharath M

S E N I O R S O F T WA R E E N G I N E E R

Details

I have around 11 years of IT experience and proficient in Java 8, I excel in developing scalable microservices using Spring Boot and implementing design patterns. My skills include multithreading, Kafka integration, and managing API gateways. With extensive experience in cloud technologies, particularly AWS, I ensure high-performance and reliable solutions. I am skilled and proficient in product development, team handling, caching, production support, and database management. I specialize in designing and solutioning for application scalability, delivering robust and efficient products.

Employment History

Application Developer, IBM India Pvt Ltd, Bengaluru

N O V E M B E R 2 0 1 9 — P R E S E N T

I gather customer requirements and understand business features based on provided designs. I suggest design improvements to architecture teams and use design patterns as needed. I provide class designs and implement POCs for complex features. I define and develop REST APIs using Spring Boot and create Spring Batch processes for large data. I implement Swagger for API documentation, build Kafka applications, test features, deploy on Private Virtual Servers, OpenShift, and manage Jenkins, Teamcity, Nolio jobs for build and deployment.

Full Stack Software Developer, Hashworks IT Services Pvt Ltd, Bengaluru

A P R I L 2 0 1 6 — O C TO B E R 2 0 1 8

I gathered requirements from customers and defined the data model for the application. I understood business features based on provided designs and defined REST APIs accordingly. I developed REST APIs using Spring Boot and created

an authentication and authorization module with Spring Security. I implemented database versioning with Flyway, method-level security, and Swagger for API documentation. I assisted the UI team during API integration, tested business features, and integrated Bitbucket for automatic continuous integration. I also implemented Jenkins and AWS S3 for automated builds and integrated AWS EC2 resources for monitoring.

Software Engineer, Tech Mahindra Pvt Ltd, Bengaluru

D E C E M B E R 2 0 1 3 — A P R I L 2 0 1 6

I had a good understanding of MVC architecture and practical knowledge of creating entity objects, view objects, view links, and associations. I designed page layouts

for a Selfcare Portal application and analyzed, designed, and developed JSPX page templates and web pages using ADF. I created a menu model template for the portal application and configured pages and templates in the WebCenter portal. I developed ADF bounded task flows, implemented both bounded and unbounded task flows, and enforced business rules for email and mobile numbers. I granted security to pages using ADF and consumed web services to populate data on developed pages.

Bengaluru India 9611096197

techie429@gmail.com
